children: Quanex Building Products reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with net sales of $501.8 million and net income of $26.5 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026. The company posted gross profit of $141.5 million (28.2% margin) and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.79. Management highlighted margin improvement, $42.25 million of debt repayments in the quarter and continued working capital progress.
Revenue (Net sales): $501.8 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up from $495.3 million in Q3 2025).
Gross profit: $141.5 million; Gross margin: 28.2% for the quarter.
Operating income: $46.5 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026.
Net income: $26.5 million for the quarter; diluted EPS: $0.58.
Adjusted diluted EPS: $0.79 and Adjusted EBITDA: $72.7 million for the quarter.
Volume trends followed normal seasonality during Q3 2026; pricing actions helped offset cost pressures from inflation and geopolitical impacts.

Segment performance: Hardware Solutions saw a 2.7% decline in net sales (lower volumes, IEEPA tariff reimbursements); Extruded Solutions grew 2.8% (pricing offset lower volumes); Custom Solutions increased 8.5% driven by higher volume and improved pricing.
Operational focus on working capital management enabled the company to repay $42.25 million of debt and repurchase 99,786 shares (~$1.7 million) in the quarter.

Liquidity and leverage: total debt was $672.2 million as of July 31, 2026 with Net Debt to LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 2.8x; liquidity totaled $363.1 million (including $62.1 million cash on hand plus revolver availability less letters of credit).
Management continues to prioritize debt repayment, opportunistic share repurchases, and identification of operational efficiencies and commercial synergies ahead of expected demand recovery.
